title: Apple is now worth over $1 trillion - here are 9 people who were convinced the iPhone would be a major flop (AAPL)
text: Apple is now worth over $1 trillion — here are 9 people who were convinced the iPhone would be a major flop (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Aug 28, 2018, 4:10 pm 46 pts Earlier this month, Apple became the first American company with a market cap over $1 trillion. That was mostly due to the iPhone, possibly the most profitable product in modern history. Last year, Apple sold over 216 million iPhones. Obviously, it's a major hit — it basically mints money for…
